requested_decision.acceptance_rule: Acceptance is valid only when the owner independently names accept-exact-candidate, repeats both exact digests, and records no unresolved exception.

review_scope: typed briefing_binding schema and status/read/write/receipt/authority invariants
positive, mutation, and hostile Dispatch Spec regressions
compiled action propagation and pre-event revalidation
task-specific raw-result admission and blocked-to-PASS prevention
canonical/generated byte parity under declared manifest exclusions

opens_only_when: All three independent owner responses accept the exact bound inventory and parent-validation digests.
Any requested revision is materialized as a new candidate with new digests and revalidation.
The original BTE, IOLM, dirty-baseline, acceptance/apply, and readiness prerequisites are independently satisfied.
The user gives fresh explicit authorization for a distinct retry run ID after all prerequisite receipts exist.

prohibitions_while_open: Do not self-issue or fabricate an owner response.
Do not promote, apply, register, commit, push, or publish the candidate.
Do not reuse the failed dispatch run ID.
Do not retry or dispatch agents from this request artifact.
Do not treat the user's candidate-authoring authorization as independent lifecycle-owner acceptance.
